issues.description: The Rideable.messageOnRide signature is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and UML specify messageOnRide() with no parameters returning a String, and the template's Main calls r.messageOnRide() without arguments. The solution, however, defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) and corresponding implementations that require an int parameter. This parameter mismatch will confuse students about the expected method signature and return value and may lead to incorrect implementations or difficulty reconciling the template examples with the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the messageOnRide signature across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution (Rideable and implementing classes) to use messageOnRide() with no parameters and return "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]", or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify and demonstrate messageOnRide(int speed) (including adjusting expected output examples). Also update the template Main call to pass an int speed if option B is chosen.
